701270101.text: "If you are reading this message, I hope that you are the one I am expecting."

701270102.text: "I've lost count of which letter this is. How far will it drift, and on what shore will it wash up?"

701270103.text: "If we ever should meet again, do tell me once more of the mountain city of stone and the snowstorms of the north. Or perhaps, tell me about dandelions and wine instead. What say you?"

701270104.text: "I will wait for your reply, as I always have."

701270201.text: "If you are reading this message, I hope that you are the one I am expecting."

701270202.text: "We once believed that war was something that only happened in fairy tales and legends. But now, each and every one of us trembles under Her Excellency's thundering wrath."

701270203.text: "The beach that we used to go to has been sealed, but I found a way to get this letter out nonetheless."

701270204.text: "Do not worry, or blame yourself for this. This deed is but trivial for one who once ventured alongside you such as I."

701270205.text: "I will wait for your reply, even if you write but a single word."
